text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's read this military chronicle today.
Fufu... legends of demon slaying, they're so romantic...
If I were one of the characters—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I suppose I'd want to be a Minamoto warrior commanding the demon subjugation. Ordinarily one would wear battle armor, but... I feel more spirited in my racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, to defeat a formidable demon, careful preparation is required...!
First, we must hold thorough war councils—

Ah, Ardan-san, found you!
Please, teach us history~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Palmer.
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Actually, tomorrow we've got a review quiz on the Heian period in history class, and... ya know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Me too, teach us, Ardan-senpai~!
Seriously, history is monster hard, it's major yabatanien!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course not at all.
Come to think of it, the book I was just reading
happens to be set in the Heian period as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
It might help deepen your understanding of the historical background,
so shall we start by going over the legend of the demon subjugation in this book?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
If you imagine what it would be like...
if you were living in that era, it is much easier to understand.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like roleplaying demon slayers~?
Sounds super fun~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please try to imagine. We are
Minamoto no Raiko, tasked with vanquishing the demons, and
his supporting Four Heavenly Kings. Now, onward to the demons' mountain stronghold—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, how about the role of Watanabe no Tsuna, renowned as the strongest of the Four Heavenly Kings?
And Helios-san, how about Sakata no Kintoki, well-known from the tale of "Kintaro"?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Me is Kintaro!? Sweet!
Gonna shoulder my axe and slay some demons, way-wa~y☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, so now we climb the mountain
and storm into the demon's hideout, right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If I may...
Though unworthy, I, Raiko, shall take command.
Let us go, Tsuna, Kintoki. Off to the demon subjugation!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
That being said, the demons are also
wary of our movements...
So as not to arouse suspicion, we shall disguise ourselves and visit openly.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So we don't look sus, does that mean
I should hide the broadaxe?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, let us conceal our weapons.
In this era, the most natural disguise in the deep mountains
would undoubtedly be a yamabushi monk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yama...bushi...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a yamabushi is,
you see, an ascetic practitioner of Shugendo who journeys across sacred mountains,
or a Buddhist monk undergoing similar mountain training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
In that era, such ascetic training was actively
practiced, so they were familiar traveler figures
frequently seen throughout the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
??? Shugen... practitioner...? 
Uhhh~... basically we're disguised as travelers, right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Demons, surrender yourselves.
I, Raiko, shall cut you down
with the legendary blade "Onikirimaru"...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Onigirimaru? Wait, like some ancient food?
Like winning their hearts through their stomachs with super delicious onigiri rice balls?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, this is not about meals,
but about a weapon. It is a prized Japanese sword of the Minamoto clan
with many legends of slaying supernatural monsters—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Supernatural slaying...? Ah sorry, hold up a sec!
I can't get the image of rice balls out of my head...
I-I'm completely losing track here~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lively voices could be heard from a corner of the cafe.
Mejiro Ardenn seemed to be slightly at a loss, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, our roleplay broke down, didn't it?
Perhaps my way of explaining was a bit too difficult...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
You see... I was just roleplaying with Palmer and Helios
as a way of studying history together.
However, I haven't been able to guide them very smoothly...
choice_data_list: How about taking a break for a bit?
Maybe try a different study method?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... when one's focus has been disrupted,
nothing makes meaningful progress anyway.
Thank you for the advice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Shall the two of you take a short break?
Since we're on the subject, why don't we have some onigiri
in honor of "Onikirimaru"?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, totally totally down for that!
Then can we shape the rice balls into cute Onigirimaru characters?
Guaranteed ultra cute☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, love that! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the three of them enjoyed making cute rice balls together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
That is true... Palmer, Helios-san,
it seems roleplaying was a bit too difficult after all,
so shall we study using the orthodox method instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uhh~~ I'm so sorry, Ardenn-san!
I know so little about history that
I just couldn't picture it well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is quite alright. I can anticipate
which questions are likely to appear on the exam,
so I will teach you the essential points first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waa~~ thank you so much!
At this point, pure rote memorization is our only hope!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, let's give this cramming everything we've got~!
...Wait, these vocab words are demonically hard,
this is unpossible sob sob sad vibes~~!!
